zh.summary: 依工作目的分組與命名資訊，再用標題、順序與動作層次幫使用者找到當下要做的事。
objectives: 區分資訊架構、導覽元件與視覺優先序。
依收件任務排列輸入、檢查、結果與次要資訊。
檢查手機閱讀順序及非顏色提示是否仍傳達相同意思。

readingGuide.goal: 區分資訊架構、導覽元件與視覺優先序。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 文字編輯器與四狀態收件草圖；只使用合成欄位名稱與資料。
readingGuide.route: 先看情境與原理，再比較例子，最後擴寫 wireframe-notes.md 並用檢核題自查。
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md 具有內容清單、群組、主要動作及手機閱讀順序。

sections.heading: 先整理內容關係，再選外觀
paragraphs: 資訊架構（Information Architecture，IA）處理內容與功能如何分組、命名及建立關係。導覽是讓人找到它們的介面方式，例如章節目錄或分頁。視覺優先序則用標題、位置、間距與對比，讓人辨識目前重點；三者有關，但不等同。
NN/G 的 IA 與導覽文章強調，內容組織會影響介面，卻不只是選擇一種導覽外觀。對本課單頁表單而言，先分清楚資料、動作與結果，再決定如何呈現；並非一定要新增側欄或多個分頁。

sections.heading: 像替文件櫃分類並貼上名稱
paragraphs: 文件櫃把資料按用途分類，是組織關係；抽屜名稱幫人知道去哪找；常用抽屜放在易取位置，則影響操作優先序。只有把所有抽屜塗上不同顏色，仍可能不知道文件屬於哪一類。
收件畫面也需要能理解的名稱。「處理」「執行」「進階」若包了不同責任，使用者可能一直猜。可以用「申請資料」「檢查結果」「匯出報告」等與任務相關的名稱，再觀察使用者是否理解；這些是本課候選命名，不是通用標準。

sections.heading: 把資訊放進可說明用途的群組
paragraphs: 本課候選分為任務說明、資料輸入、檢查與結果、次要說明。必要欄位與主要動作保持靠近，結果要說明對應哪次輸入。只有不影響當前決定的補充資訊才延後呈現，不能把錯誤藏進「進階」造成猜測。
主要動作可以隨狀態改變：未檢查時是檢查資料，缺件時是補填後重新檢查，完成時才出現當次預覽與匯出。不要同時擺出多個看似等價的完成按鈕，讓人誤以為所有動作都能隨時執行。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜依用途分組的畫面資訊
blocks.description: 卡片表示資訊群組，不是四個可互換的畫面；手機仍需保持合理閱讀順序。

items.title: 任務與限制
items.body: 說明此工具檢查三個合成欄位，完整不代表正式受理。

items.title: 資料與標籤
items.body: 申請編號、申請人代號、文件類型，各有可辨識名稱及必要說明。

items.title: 動作與結果
items.body: 目前可做的主要動作、缺漏與修正方式、當次預覽和匯出。

items.title: 次要資訊
items.body: 範例或技術診斷另有位置；影響當前工作的錯誤不放在此處。

sections.heading: 比較能支援決定的安排
paragraphs: 下表是本課的文字版介面對照，供畫線框稿時參考，並非測試後的最佳版。你仍需依實際使用者的資料取得方式與裝置調整。
表單欄位需要持續可辨識的名稱；placeholder（輸入提示字）可能在輸入後消失，不能當作唯一的欄位說明。W3C 的表單指南還要求標籤與控制項具有程式可辨識的關聯，這要在實作時核對，光畫在旁邊不會自動完成。

blocks.caption: 表 1｜同一工作內容的兩種安排
rows: 先顯示大幅歡迎圖，欄位藏到下方
任務說明後直接提供必要欄位
現在可以開始輸入什麼
只有輸入框內的提示字
保留可見欄位名稱，必要時補範例
輸入後仍知道各值的用途
缺件結果只寫紅色 INVALID
文字指出缺少文件類型與修正動作
哪裡出錯、怎麼回復
檢查與匯出一直並列且同等強調

目前應檢查還是可匯出
診斷設定比結果更顯眼
診斷移到次要區，結果直接可見
當次工作是否完成

sections.heading: 手機重排也要保留意思
paragraphs: 桌面並排輸入與說明，手機通常會上下堆疊。如果畫面順序與文件中的閱讀順序互相矛盾，鍵盤或輔助科技使用者可能在看到說明之前就進入動作。對有先後意義的內容，要讓程式可辨識的閱讀順序仍合理。
W3C 的 Meaningful Sequence 說明適用於順序會影響意思的情況，不要求所有獨立卡片都只有唯一順序。本課先以任務→輸入→結果安排，再實測窄版、鍵盤與線性閱讀；CSS 排列看起來正確，不代表所有操作順序都正確。

sections.heading: 先做內容清單，再畫位置
paragraphs: 將所有資訊寫成清單，為每項標用途、重要條件與群組。刪掉與任務無關的內容之前，先確認是否有別的角色需要；必要的狀態與復原資訊即使不常發生，也不能因為使用頻率低就藏起來。
常見誤解是「主要按鈕一定靠右」。位置不是跨所有裝置與使用者的固定答案；更重要的是名稱、狀態與前後文可理解，而且鍵盤能依合理順序到達。把具體假設留在草圖，讓走讀與實作驗證能回應它。

blocks.heading: 資訊分組筆記
paragraphs: 將以下合成範例放入 wireframe-notes.md，依你的課堂情境修改；這不是實際單位規定或研究結果。
blocks.code:
# 畫面資訊清單（合成候選）
任務：三個必要欄位的完整性檢查
輸入：三欄名稱、必填說明、合成範例
主要動作：依狀態提供檢查或當次完整匯出
結果：缺漏欄位、修正方式、完成定義、預覽
次要：補充範例與技術診斷；錯誤不可藏在此處
閱讀順序：任務 → 輸入 → 檢查與結果
實作待驗：標籤關聯、手機重排、鍵盤焦點順序

exercise.environment: 文字編輯器與四狀態收件草圖；只使用合成欄位名稱與資料。
steps: 盤點必要欄位、動作、狀態、範例與診斷資訊，為每項指定用途與群組。
為未檢查、缺件、完成各選主要動作，寫出不能被隱藏的資訊。
用紙筆排出桌面與手機版本，線性讀出標題、欄位、結果與動作，記錄一項需要實作驗證的順序問題。
exercise.expected: wireframe-notes.md 具有內容清單、群組、主要動作及手機閱讀順序。
exercise.check: 名稱可理解，錯誤不只靠顏色或位置；能說明分組與導覽外觀的差異。
exercise.cleanup: 保留候選與待驗標記；不把個人偏好的位置或配色寫成普遍驗證結論。

en.summary: Group and name information around work goals, then use headings, order and action hierarchy to help users find what matters now.
objectives: Distinguish information architecture, navigation components and visual hierarchy.
Arrange input, checking, results and secondary information around the intake task.
Check that mobile reading order and non-color cues retain the same meaning.

readingGuide.goal: Distinguish information architecture, navigation components and visual hierarchy.
readingGuide.startingPoint: A text editor and four-state intake sketches, using synthetic field names and data only.
readingGuide.route: Read the situation and principles, compare examples, then expand wireframe-notes.md and use the checks to review your understanding.
readingGuide.output: wireframe-notes.md with a content inventory, groups, primary actions and mobile reading order.

sections.heading: Organize Relationships Before Choosing Appearance
paragraphs: Information Architecture (IA) concerns grouping, naming and relationships among content and functions. Navigation is how an interface helps people reach them, such as a contents list or tabs. Visual hierarchy uses headings, placement, spacing and contrast to identify priorities. They relate but are not equivalent.

NN/G distinguishes content organization from navigation appearance. For this single-page form, first separate data, actions and results before choosing presentation; adding a sidebar or multiple tabs is not mandatory.

sections.heading: Classify and Label a Filing Cabinet
paragraphs: Grouping documents by purpose establishes organization. Drawer labels tell people where to look, while frequently used drawers within reach affect access priority. Giving every drawer a different color may still leave document categories unclear.

Intake screens also need understandable names. “Process,” “Execute” and “Advanced” can make users guess when they hide different responsibilities. Try task-related labels such as “Application data,” “Check results” and “Export report,” then observe understanding. These are course candidates, not universal names.

sections.heading: Give Each Group an Explainable Purpose
paragraphs: The course proposes task guidance, data input, checking/results and secondary information. Keep required fields near the primary action and identify which input produced a result. Defer only information irrelevant to the current decision; do not hide errors under “Advanced.”

Primary actions can change with state: check initially, recheck after correction, then preview and export current results only when complete. Several equally emphasized completion buttons can imply that all actions are always available.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Information Grouped by Purpose
blocks.description: These cards represent information groups, not four interchangeable screens. Preserve sensible reading order on mobile.

items.title: Task and limits
items.body: Explain that the tool checks three synthetic fields and completeness does not mean official acceptance.

items.title: Data and labels
items.body: Application number, applicant code and document type each have an identifiable name and necessary guidance.

items.title: Actions and results
items.body: Available primary action, omissions and correction, current preview and export.

items.title: Secondary information
items.body: Examples or diagnostics have a separate place; errors affecting current work do not belong here.

sections.heading: Compare Arrangements That Support Decisions
paragraphs: The table is a textual interface comparison for wireframing, not a tested optimum. Adjust it for intended users’ data sources and devices.

Fields need identifiable names that remain understandable after entry. Placeholder text can disappear and must not be the only explanation. W3C’s forms guidance also calls for programmatic label/control associations. Verify these in implementation; drawing a label nearby does not establish the association.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | Two Arrangements of the Same Work Content
rows: Large welcome image before fields hidden below
Provide required fields after task guidance.
What can I enter now?
Only placeholder text inside inputs
Retain visible field names and add examples where needed.
What is each entered value for?
Missing-input result says only red INVALID
Name missing document type and explain correction in text.
What went wrong and how can I recover?
Checking and export are always equally prominent
Offer actions and limits according to actual state.
Should I check now or can I export?
Diagnostics are more prominent than results
Move diagnostics to a secondary area; keep results visible.
Has the current task finished?

sections.heading: Retain Meaning When Mobile Layout Reflows
paragraphs: Desktop input and guidance may sit side by side and stack on mobile. If visual and document reading order conflict, keyboard or assistive-technology users may reach an action before its explanation. Where sequence matters, keep a sensible programmatically determinable reading order.

W3C’s Meaningful Sequence explanation applies when order affects meaning; independent cards need not have only one valid order. Start with task → input → results, then test narrow layouts, keyboards and linear reading. Correct-looking CSS alone does not establish correct operation order.

sections.heading: Inventory Content Before Positioning It
paragraphs: List information with its purpose, important conditions and group. Before removing material irrelevant to one task, check whether another role needs it. Rare but necessary status and recovery information must not be hidden just because it is infrequent.

A common mistake is prescribing right-aligned primary buttons universally. Placement is not fixed across every device and user. Understandable names, state and context, plus a sensible keyboard path, matter more. Record concrete hypotheses in the sketch for walkthrough and implementation checks.

blocks.heading: Information Grouping Notes
paragraphs: The original Traditional Chinese template lists the task, three labeled synthetic inputs, state-dependent primary action, results/correction/completeness definition, secondary information excluding errors, reading order and pending label/mobile/focus checks. Adapt it in wireframe-notes.md; it is not actual rules or research results.
blocks.code:
# 畫面資訊清單（合成候選）
任務：三個必要欄位的完整性檢查
輸入：三欄名稱、必填說明、合成範例
主要動作：依狀態提供檢查或當次完整匯出
結果：缺漏欄位、修正方式、完成定義、預覽
次要：補充範例與技術診斷；錯誤不可藏在此處
閱讀順序：任務 → 輸入 → 檢查與結果
實作待驗：標籤關聯、手機重排、鍵盤焦點順序

exercise.environment: A text editor and four-state intake sketches, using synthetic field names and data only.
steps: Inventory required fields, actions, states, examples and diagnostics, giving each a purpose and group.
Choose primary actions for unchecked, missing-input and complete states, and identify information that cannot be hidden.
Arrange desktop and mobile versions on paper. Read headings, fields, results and actions linearly and record an ordering question needing implementation testing.
exercise.expected: wireframe-notes.md with a content inventory, groups, primary actions and mobile reading order.
exercise.check: Names are understandable and errors rely on more than color or position. Explain grouping versus navigation appearance.
exercise.cleanup: Keep candidate and pending labels. Do not present personal placement or color preferences as universal tested conclusions.

zh.prompt: 哪一項最接近資訊架構的工作？
options: 為所有按鈕加陰影
先選側欄顏色
規劃內容與功能的分組、名稱及關係
決定程式碼縮排
rationales: 這是視覺樣式，不是內容關係。
導覽外觀應回應內容與任務。
這些決策影響使用者如何找到資訊與理解用途。
這是程式碼風格。

en.prompt: Which activity best represents information architecture?
options: Add shadows to all buttons.
Choose the sidebar color first.
Plan groups, names and relationships among content and functions.
Choose code indentation.
rationales: This is visual styling, not content relationships.
Navigation appearance should follow content and task needs.
These decisions affect finding information and understanding its purpose.
This is code style.

zh.prompt: 只把「文件類型」寫在輸入框 placeholder，可能有什麼問題？
options: 任何輸入都會變成完整
輸入後提示消失，也未必有程式可辨識標籤關聯
一定會導致伺服器故障
等同通過鍵盤測試
rationales: 標籤安排不會自動改變檢核規則。
需要持續可辨識的名稱，實作還要核對標籤關聯。
這不是必然的伺服器問題。
鍵盤與標籤仍需分別實測。

en.prompt: What may go wrong if “document type” appears only as placeholder text?
options: Every input automatically becomes complete.
The guidance disappears after entry and may lack a programmatic label association.
The server must fail.
It is equivalent to passing a keyboard test.
rationales: Label design does not automatically alter checking rules.
Retain identifiable field names and verify label association in implementation.
This is not necessarily a server problem.
Keyboard operation and labels need separate testing.

zh.prompt: 桌面改成手機排版，哪個檢查較合適？
options: 只要看起來縮小就算完成
所有卡片必須有唯一順序
只檢查滑鼠能否點擊
確認有意義的內容順序、實際閱讀與鍵盤路徑仍合理
rationales: 縮小可能讓文字或操作難以理解。
獨立內容不一定只有唯一順序。
手機與鍵盤路徑仍可能有問題。
檢查對應資訊與操作的實際意義。

en.prompt: What should be checked when desktop layout becomes mobile layout?
options: A smaller-looking page is sufficient.
All cards must have one unique order.
Only mouse clicking.
Meaningful content order, actual reading and keyboard paths remain sensible.
rationales: Shrinking can make text or actions hard to understand.
Independent content need not have a unique order.
Mobile and keyboard paths may still have problems.
These checks address the actual meaning of information and actions.
